models.verdict: Agent-specialized MoE: strongest on tool/agent benches, weaker on knowledge/coding than Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. M1 Max ~90-140 tok/s estimated from the vendor's 184 tok/s M5 Max claim (bandwidth-scaled, unverified) — no community Apple Silicon measurement exists as of 2026-10-14. Caveats: vendor claim is decode-only — prefill cost and KV-cache pressure at 131K context are unaddressed.
